def factor_liquidity_impact_asymmetry_pure(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    up_impact = intraday_ret.clip(lower=0.0) * np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    down_impact = (-intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0)) * np.where(is_low_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    up_vol = up_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    down_vol = down_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    denom = (up_vol + down_vol).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = (up_vol - down_vol) / denom
    df_copy["factor_liquidity_impact_asymmetry_pure"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_liquidity_impact_asymmetry_pure"]
description: Preserves the core liquidity-conditioned asymmetric price impact from liq_vol_impact_asym_001: positive intraday moves on high-volume days reflect demand absorption, negative moves on low-volume days reflect illiquidity pressure. This mutation removes the rolling session-sign agreement multiplier from the crossover parent because the herding consensus weight adds a second mechanism that may dilute the raw asymmetry's linear correlation and RankIC stability. The child returns to a pure volume-conditioned asymmetry with one core mechanism and no auxiliary modifier, targeting improved IC while retaining the parent's established payoff and monotonicity. Parent strength target: liquidity-conditioned asymmetric price impact.
